args.subject: Group Booking Inquiry - 10 people in June
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

My name is Emma Johnson, and I am representing Blue Sparrow Tech. I am writing to inquire about group booking availability for 10 people at your hotel in June.

Could you please provide information on:
- Room availability for a group of 10 in June
- Room types and rates
- Any group-specific amenities or policies
- Booking process and requirements

I would appreciate a prompt response as we are planning our stay soon.

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
